system.one_liner: Two RL agents trained against each other: an adversary generating hard instances and an algorithm agent learning a robust online matching algorithm.

content.variant_note: two mirrored RL loops that each treat the other as environment, closed into a cycle by two thick arcs that hand over worst-case instances and a robust algorithm
content.argues: Two RL agents that treat each other as the environment, one producing worst-case instances and one producing a robust algorithm, can be trained iteratively against each other.
content.subject: Two mirrored RL loops, an adversary agent and an algorithm agent, linked by arrows carrying worst-case instances and a robust algorithm.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show an adversarial or co-trained pair by drawing the same RL loop twice (the second flipped) inside dashed regions with rotated titles, then close the cycle with two thick outer arcs named by what each agent hands to the other.
lessons.suits: Min-max, adversarial, GAN-like, self-play or alternating-optimisation frameworks where two learners treat each other as the environment.

evidence: Each agent views the other as its environment, and rewards are opposite to each other.
Figure 1. Our adversarial reinforcement learning framework.

summary: The paper studies online matching with stochastic rewards (OMSR) and uses adversarial reinforcement learning to learn a robust algorithm and to discover hard instances, from which two structural properties are distilled to improve the known hardness bound from 0.621 to 0.597. Figure 1 draws the framework as two mirrored RL loops inside dashed rounded regions titled Adversary agent and Algorithm agent. Each loop has an Agent box holding Policy and RL Alg. and an Environment box, joined by Observation, Action and Reward arrows. Two thick curved arrows close the cycle: Worst-case instances go from the adversary's agent to the algorithm agent's environment, and the Robust Algorithm goes back to the adversary's environment. The drawing is monochrome serif line art.
summary_zh: 论文用对抗强化学习研究带随机奖励的在线匹配。图1画出两个镜像的强化学习回路：对手智能体与算法智能体互为环境，两条粗弧线分别传递最坏情形实例和鲁棒算法，构成闭环。全图为单色线稿。
notes: The prior second kind concept-schematic is dropped: the figure is a framework diagram of two RL loops, not an abstract-idea picture; stage-pipeline (closed-loop) is added for the iterative cycle drawn by the two arcs. In the right region the arrows labelled Action (left, running from Environment down to Agent) and Observation (right, running from Agent up to Environment) run opposite to the left loop and to the usual RL convention; recorded as drawn, the paper text does not explain it. The two dashed regions are counted as panels because each is framed and titled, although the arcs tie them into one cycle.
